picks.name: apkstart
picks.desc: Windows 上的安卓应用运行器：双击 APK 即装，应用以独立窗口与桌面图标运行，自持 QEMU 运行时
picks.readme:
# ApkStart

[![CI](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RoutineMiku/apkstart?include_prereleases&sort=semver)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20x64-0078D6.svg)](#) **Windows 上的安卓应用运行器 —— 让安卓应用像 Windows 原生软件一样被安装和使用。** 注：本项目为早期版本，作者自娱自乐产物，所有修改都是作者下班和休息日在处理，开源免费，不插广告，暂时也不是很好用，没有找过营销号推广，无妄之灾。 - 🖱️ **双击 .apk 即安装**：注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK，自动解析 → 安装 → 生成桌面图标，全程无需打开任何模拟器界面。 - 🧩 **每个应用一个桌面图标**：图标从 APK 内部离线提取并转为多尺寸 ICO，双击桌面图标 = 直接启动该应用，与打开一个原生 Windows 软件的体验一致。 - 🪟 **应用就是一个窗口**：运行时以**带窗口**模式启动（无头模式下 Android 不出 VSYNC，应用进程活着但屏幕上是空的），ApkStart 把这块窗口改标题、换真实应用图标、按竖屏比例摆好位置，就是一个独立应用窗口；**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中，**窗口模式**可自由拖动缩放且按应用记忆尺寸。 - 🔍 **能被 Windows 搜到**：安装后同时创建桌面 + 开始菜单（`程序\ApkStart\`）快捷方式，按应用名在开始菜单搜索即可直达，任务栏按应用分组。 - 📁 **数据互通**：`%USERPROFILE%\ApkStartShared` ↔ 安卓内 `/sdcard/ApkStartShared` 持续双向同步，安卓应用存下的文件直接出现在本机。 - 🪶 **极致轻量**：壳层本身零第三方依赖（连 ZIP / PNG / ICO / AXML 解析都是手写的），运行时按需拉起，空闲自动回收；也可以完全复用你机器上已有的安卓运行时，额外占用为零。 ![主界面](docs/images/app.png) ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 桌面图标（真实应用图标 .lnk） │ │ │ 双击 │ │ ▼ │ │ ApkStart.exe --launch <包名> │ │ │ 运行时未启动？→ 自动拉起（Android Emulator + API34）│ │ ▼ │ │ 按系统解析出的 LAUNCHER 入口启动（不是 APK 里的主 Activity）│ │ │ 存活观察 18 秒，闪退自动重试 / 重置数据 / 补权限 │ │ ▼ │ │ 模拟器窗口 = 应用窗口（改标题、换图标、竖屏比例、全屏居中） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 下载即用（不想编译） 两个源内容一致，国内建议用 Gitee： - GitHub：[github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) - Gitee：[gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases](https://gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases)（国内直连快得多） 安装包（三种形态，内容与版本号完全一致）： | 形态 | 文件名 | 何时选它 | |---|---|---| | 商店版 | `ApkStart_<四段版本>_x64.msix` | 从 Microsoft Store 装。内置完整运行时，装完不联网；自更新交给商店 | | 完整便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-full.zip`（约 830 MB，解压 ~1.3 GB） | **不想装、也不想等下载**：解压即用，运行时（模拟器 + 系统镜像）全在包里 | | 安装版 | `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe`（约 1.3 GB） | 想要桌面/开始菜单快捷方式、卸载项 | | 轻量便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`（96 MiB，解压 ~227 MB） | 只想先试试，首次启动再联网下载运行时 | > 所有形态的 `ApkStart.exe` 都写入了**品牌图标 + 版本资源**（FileDescription = `ApkStart 安卓应用运行器`， > CompanyName = `RoutineMiku`，版本与 `package.json` 同步），不再是 Electron 的默认图标和 `33.x` 版本号。 > 自己从源码打包时：`npm run pack`（轻量）/ `npm run pack:full`（完整）/ `npm run build:msix`（商店包）。 ### 画面铺满是怎么做到的 模拟器的**物理面板方向**（`hw.lcd.width/height`）就是画面的真实形状。面板方向和应用自己声明的 `screenOrientation` 不一致时，Android 只会给应用一个信箱式的中间窄条 —— 两侧补黑，换窗口大小、 改 `wm size`、改 letterbox 样式都填不满（这套组合逐项试过，见 `src/core/apk.js` 的注释）。 所以 ApkStart 在**安装 APK 时离线解析 `AndroidManifest.xml`**，统计出这个应用天然是横屏还是竖屏 （启动 Activity 加权；全 `sensor` / `fullSensor` 的会在首次运行后再问安卓要一次实际值），存进 `apps.json`，启动时按它选面板： - 红果短剧这类竖屏应用 → 竖屏面板 720×1280，正立、铺满、density 190（sw606dp）同时给出平板排版； - 墨读这类横屏应用 → 横屏面板 1280×720，正立、铺满。 只有「面板方向和应用方向不一致」的那一次才重启运行时（约 40 秒，标题栏会给出提示）， 之后同方向的应用都是秒进。标题栏的旋转按钮会把这个应用的方向**记住**（其它应用不受影响）， 设置 → 应用窗口 → 屏幕方向可以改成「强制横屏 / 强制竖屏」。 排版由「逻辑密度」决定：720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 **606dp**，正好越过 Android 的 600dp 平板断点， 红果短剧的双列剧集页、设置页分栏都只在这个密度下出现（镜像默认 320dpi 只有 360dp，是手机排版）。 这就是设置里的「平板排版」开关，默认打开；关掉会回到手机排版。 ### 在线更新（自动选较快的源） 设置 → **软件更新** → 「检查更新」，或托盘右键 → 「检查更新」。发现新版本后点「立即更新」即可。 - 安装版下载 `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe` 静默安装； - 轻量版下载 `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`，解压后覆盖**程序目录**——运行时目录（`%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）、已装应用与快照都不在程序目录里，所以更新不会丢东西； - 替换动作由一段独立 PowerShell 脚本完成（等主进程退出 → 覆盖 → 重新拉起），**不会出现「请手动关闭程序」的弹窗**，也不会在桌面上残留模拟器窗口。 更新链路不是死连 GitHub

picks.name: Claude-Cage
picks.desc: Cage：为 Claude 特化的轻量化虚拟机，彻底杜绝网络泄露。多平台适配，支持多账号管理、远程部署、移动端操控。
picks.readme:
Claude Cage

**把 Claude 大小姐关起来，为了更好地保护我们的相遇** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/) · [下载应用](https://claude-cage.com/#download) · [使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/) · [常见问题](https://claude-cage.com/docs/troubleshooting/)** [简体中文](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [العربية](README.ar.md) · [فارسی](README.fa.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [မြန်မာဘာသာ](README.my.md) · [Беларуская](README.be.md) · [پښتو](README.ps.md) · [دری](README.prs.md) · [አማርኛ](README.am.md) · [Soomaali](README.so.md) · [ትግርኛ](README.ti.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)
## 受够了 Anthropic 作为一个只是想和 Claude 对话与合作的正常用户，受够了折腾各种 VPS，指纹浏览器，环境检测，面对封号的担惊受怕和财产损失。我们提出 **Claude Cage** 项目：**一个开箱即用的桌面程序，配置好自己的网络代理，集中管理隔离环境、时区语言和环境检查。** Claude Cage 让你在熟悉的系统里与 Claude 一起工作：Mac 上用 macOS 虚拟机，Windows 上用 Windows 虚拟机，也可以选择轻量的 Linux 环境。终端、浏览器、编辑器和官方 Claude Desktop 汇集在同一个工作台，项目按需共享，网络独立管理；还可以连接自己的服务器，或用手机接续电脑上的任务。支持以下几个重点功能： - 和主机隔离的网络设置，Cage 自己接管和代理内部的所有网络流量 - 和主机隔离的指纹设置，包括时区、语言等，支持自动与代理 IP 同步 - 针对 Claude 使用过程中的全链路适配（浏览器登录，授权，claude code 进程） - 内置网络与隔离检查，关键检查失败或证据不完整时暂停外网；社区和第三方检测提供补充参考 **使用 Cage 的环境检测结果：** | 网络与隔离检查 | 浏览器环境检测（社区参考） | | :---: | :---: | | | | [FuckClaude](https://fuck-claude.vercel.app/) · [LinXiaoTao / GitHub](https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude) **Cage 运行主界面：** ![Cage](www/public/workbench-2026-11.jpg) ## 你可以用它做什么 - **在一个窗口里完成工作。** 用终端运行 Claude Code，用编辑器查看改动，用 Cage 浏览器预览服务和完成登录。 - **用熟悉的系统开发。** 选择 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 客机，使用对应平台的工具；也可自动匹配本机系统版本，下载官方镜像并创建独立环境。 [选择客机系统](docs/guide/guest-systems.md) - **控制共享范围。** 只共享默认工作区和明确打开的项目文件夹；主机的 Claude 登录、浏览器配置和 SSH 密钥不会自动导入。 - **看清网络状态。** 内置代理管理支持导入订阅、选择节点和检查出口。关键检查未通过时，环境保持离线；代理不可用时没有直连回退。 - **下次继续使用。** 工具、文件和登录状态保存在虚拟磁盘里，关闭窗口可以保留后台任务。 - **管理多个 Claude Code 订阅。** 查看额度、为新会话分配账号，并在明确授权后切换账号接续历史。 [Claude Code](docs/guide/accounts.md) - **从手机继续处理任务。** Android / iPhone 配对电脑，接续 Claude Code 对话与工具审批，或操作远程浏览器和 Claude Desktop。[手机连接](docs/guide/mobile.md) - **把环境放到自己的服务器。** 通过 SSH 部署或连接 Linux VPS，工具、任务和数据留在服务器，无需 KVM。[云端部署与 SSH](docs/guide/cloud.md) - **通过私网连接设备。** 在 Cage 内登录 Tailscale，查看网络中的设备，使用 SSH、Web 与其他 TCP 服务。 [Tailscale 私网](docs/guide/tailscale.md) 浏览器收藏、无痕会话、Cookie、扩展、密码保险箱，以及外观、资源、存储和工具更新，见[完整使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/)。 ## 快速开始 把这句话发给你的 agent（codex，dsh，workbuddy，反正不会是 claude code😁） ```markdown 帮我拉取 https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage 的最新源码，打包安装，并把 Cage 的代理配置通过我本机 clash 的 xx 节点走我的 xx ip 出口，全过程你盯着，有问题直接修复，且有必要的话顺手给项目提交 issue 帮助他们优化兼容性。 ``` 你唯一需要的，是一个靠谱的代理节点，本项目不做任何代理推广，可以自行搜索黑色错误网站解决。 ## 下载与安装 Cage

# ![SkillEvaluator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/ad2815fe78c045db91d230681d32863698da08cf/docs/assets/skillevaluator-wordmark.svg)

Evaluate and improve AI agent skills and plugins: quality, security, overlap, compatibility, and real impact across agents

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12%20%7C%203.13%20%7C%203.14-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/skillevaluator.svg?label=PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/skillevaluator/) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/Documentation-docs.nvidia.com-blue.svg)](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2608.20614-b31b1b.svg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20614) [![Blog](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blog-NVIDIA%20Developer-76B900.svg)](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/evaluating-ai-agent-skill-performance-with-nvidia-skillevaluator/) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/forks)
> 📺 **Livestream:** [Ask the Experts: Evaluating Agent Skills](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rI0zATFxYI) SkillEvaluator checks AI agent skills and plugins, and measures a skill's effect on task results: start with quality checks, then compare runs with and without a skill. Agent skills are folders of instructions and supporting files defined by the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/). SkillEvaluator is part of the [NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills). ## Get started Install the CLI in a Python 3.12–3.14 environment: ```bash pip install skillevaluator ```
Or use uv ```bash uv tool install --python 3.13 skillevaluator ```
For uv setup or direct GitHub source installation, see [Installation](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation). Then check skills from your terminal, CI, or agent:

Quickly check your skill without an LLM key: ```bash skillevaluator quality-check ./my-skill ``` After [all-tier setup with NVIDIA Build](#run-all-three-tiers-with-a-free-nvidia-build-key), run the combined pipeline: ```bash skillevaluator validate \ ./my-skill ```

Our CI template checks every skill change, no code to maintain. Run in your GitHub repo to open a setup PR: ```bash skillevaluator ci init ``` GitLab details: [repository guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/repository-integration).

Add the skill to Claude Code, Codex or another agent: ```bash npx skills add \ NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator ``` Then ask: *"Is my skill any good?"* See the [agent guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/agent-skill).
### ⚡ [Harness check](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/harness-check): will your agent load your skill? Requires [GitHub source](https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skillevaluator/installation); not in PyPI 0.9.0. No model key or agent run. ```bash skillevaluator harness-check ./my-skill ``` Illustrative summary of versioned profiles.

#
🎻 PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing
Yiwen Song1, Yale Song1, Tomas Pfister1, and Jinsung Yoon1
1Google Cloud AI Research


PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials (ideas and experimental logs) into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams. Acting like an orchestrated team of specialized agents, it handles outline generation, literature review, section writing, content refinement, and plotting to close the gap between raw research materials and submission ready papers.
## Key Features - **Multi-Agent Pipeline**: Orchestrates specialized agents (Outline, Literature Review, Section Writing, Content Refinement, Plotting) for end-to-end paper generation. - **Comprehensive Literature Synthesis**: Automatically searches, prioritizes, and integrates relevant literature into the manuscript. - **Visuals Generation**: Generates plots and supports the inclusion of conceptual diagrams. - **LaTeX Automation**: Produces submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts adhering to target conference templates. ## Installation 1. **Environment Setup**: The project relies on a Conda environment named `paper_orchestra`. You can set up a similar environment with Python 3.11 and install the required dependencies. ```bash conda create -n paper_orchestra python=3.11 conda activate paper_orchestra pip install -r requirements.txt ``` 2. **Environment Variables**: Create a `.env` file in the root of the project and add your API keys: ```env # Add keys if you have them, otherwise leave them empty # You need to specify related keys if you want to use the model # For example, if you want to use Gemini models, you need to specify either VERTEX_AI_PROJECT and VERTEX_AI_LOCATION, or GEMINI_API_KEY # If you want to use OpenAI models, you need to specify OPENAI_API_KEY SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY=your_semantic_scholar_api_key OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key VERTEX_AI_PROJECT=your_vertex_ai_project VERTEX_AI_LOCATION=your_vertex_ai_location GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key # if you want to run demo and send emails to yourself at the end, set these 2 fields as well SMTP_EMAIL=your_email SMTP_PASSWORD=your_password ``` ## Dataset The dataset used for paper generation is **not included** in this code repository. It will be released separately at a later date. Once available, you should download the dataset and place it under the `datasets/` directory. ## Usage You can run the paper generation pipeline using the provided bash script or directly via the Python CLI. ### Using the Bash Script ```bash ./paper_writing_cli.sh ``` ### Using the Python CLI directly ```bash python paper_writing_cli.py \ --raw_materials_dir /path_to_your_raw_materials/ \ --latex_template_dir /path_to_your_latex_template/ \ --output_dir /path_to_your_output_folder/ \ --use_plotting true ``` ### Key Arguments * `--raw_materials_dir`: (Required) Directory containing the raw materials (e.g., idea and experimental log). * `--latex_template_dir`: (Required) Directory containing the LaTeX template (e.g., `templates/cvpr2025`). * `--output_dir`: Directory to output the generated paper. If not specified, an automatic folder with a timestamp is created. * `--use_plotting`: Enable the plotting agent workflow to generate figures from code (Default: `False`). * `--writer_model_name`: LLM for writer and literature agents. * `--reflection_model_name`: LLM for reflection agents. ### Interactive Demo We provide an i

picks.desc: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
picks.readme:
# /last30days English | [Français](README.fr.md) | [Deutsch](README.de.md) | [Español](README.es.md) | [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [العربية](README.ar.md)



**An AI agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes, and real money - not editors.** This README tracks the current v4 pipeline. The runtime skill spec lives in [skills/last30days/SKILL.md](skills/last30days/SKILL.md), which is the source of truth for the latest command and setup behavior. **Claude Code (recommended — auto-updates via marketplace):** ``` /plugin marketplace add mvanhorn/last30days-skill /plugin install last30days ``` **Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or any of 50+ [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) hosts:** ``` npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g ``` (`-g` installs globally for your user, available across all projects. Drop it to scope per-project.) More install options (claude.ai web, OpenClaw, manual) in the [Install](#install) section below. Zero config. Reddit, HN, Polymarket, and GitHub work immediately, and so do patent filings and careers pages when your topic is a company. Run it once and the setup wizard unlocks X, YouTube, TikTok, arXiv, Techmeme, and more in 30 seconds. --- Reddit upvotes. X likes. YouTube transcripts. TikTok engagement. Polymarket odds backed by real money and insider information. That's millions of people voting with their attention and their wallets every day. /last30days searches all of it in parallel, scores it by what real people actually engage with, and an AI agent judge synthesizes it into one brief. Google aggregates editors. /last30days searches people. You can't get this search anywhere else because no single AI has access to all of it. Google search doesn't touch Reddit comments or X posts. ChatGPT has a deal with Reddit but can't search X or TikTok. Gemini has YouTube but not Reddit. Claude has none of them natively. Each platform is a walled garden with its own API, its own tokens, its own auth. But you can bring your own keys and browser sessions, and suddenly an AI agent can search all of them at once, score them against each other, and tell you what actually matters. That's the unlock. Not one better search engine. A dozen disconnected platforms, bridged by an agent. ``` /last30days Peter Steinberger ``` You have a meeting tomorrow. You Google them. You get their LinkedIn from 2023. /last30days gives you what they're actually doing this month: joined OpenAI to work on Codex, fighting Anthropic's ban on third-party agents, shipping 23 PRs at 85% merge rate, building "LobsterOS" for cross-device agent control, and r/ClaudeCode hit 569 upvotes debating whether he's a hero or "insufferable." Scattered across X posts, Reddit threads, YouTube transcripts, and GitHub commits. None of it was on Google. ## Why this exists I built it to keep up in AI. Everything changes every day and the Reddit and X nerds are always on top of it first. I needed better prompts, and the training data was always months behind
